name: Cardiovascular Endurance
description: Measures the efficiency of the heart, lungs, and circulatory system during sustained physical activity.

name: Muscular Strength
description: Measures the maximum force a muscle or muscle group can produce in a single effort.

name: Muscular Endurance
description: Measures a muscle or muscle group's ability to sustain repeated contractions over time.

name: Flexibility
description: Measures the range of motion available at a joint or group of joints.

name: Speed
description: Measures the ability to move the body or parts of the body rapidly.

name: Agility
description: Measures the ability to change direction quickly and accurately.

name: Power
description: Measures the ability to exert maximum muscular contraction instantly in an explosive burst of movements.

name: Balance
description: Measures the ability to maintain the body's center of gravity within its base of support.

name: Coordination
description: Measures the ability to use the senses together with body parts during movement.

name: Reaction Time
description: Measures the time it takes to respond to a stimulus.
